note: Six interleaved pairs on one host, alternating which runtime ran first. The parent clones the topic string into the fetch-return map on every batch. The candidate updates an existing map entry and clones the name only the first time a topic is seen. Every run verified 20,000 records and validation_failures stayed 0. Allocation count fell from 359 to 90 on every run, and allocated bytes fell from 38665440 to 38663288. Before median 706,555 records/s, after median 721,204. Paired mean ratio 1.051, bootstrap 95% CI 0.853 to 1.254. The interval includes 1, so this is not claimed on the wall-clock route. Client CPU-nanoseconds per record mean ratio was 0.987. Three of six pairs were slower. Not a fetch comparison against other clients and not a fastest-client result.
